summary: Too big for one change (35+ files, 2500+ lines): new institution tenant model, DRT/DRAT/NCLT adapters, portfolio service, billing plan, alerts and web UI; split into 6 sub-issues

subissues.title: feat(b2b): portfolio data model for institutions (org workspace kind, portfolio, panel advocates) (#498 part 1)
subissues.body: Part of #498. Add tenant tables `portfolio`, `portfolio_case` (proceeding or CNR/case number, source, status fields, next date, last adverse order) and `portfolio_panel_advocate` (advocate user delegated for the institution), plus a workspace kind for institutions, a migration (next free number), FORCE RLS via tenantTable(), and update packages/db/src/index.test.ts, the RLS catalog in packages/db/src/__tests__/rls/sql.test.ts, TABLE_TESTS/registry and the two-tenant seeders. Acceptance: RLS tests prove tenant B sees nothing of A.

subissues.title: feat(adapters): DRT, DRAT and national NCLT status and cause-list adapters (#498 part 2)
subissues.body: Part of #498. Add DRT/DRAT status and cause-list parsers and NCLT benches nationally (extending nclt-blr, #38) with golden fixtures, registered in the adapter registry and forum catalogue config. SARFAESI DM/CMM matters are tracked through eCourts sources already present. Acceptance: parsers pass golden fixtures offline.

subissues.title: feat(core): portfolio service with CSV import, bulk watches and dashboard queries (#498 part 3)
subissues.body: Part of #498. `packages/core/src/portfolio/`: import a CSV of case numbers or CNRs (up to 1,000 rows) creating portfolio cases and delegated watches under the panel advocates or cleared sources (never bulk captcha, #492), within the poll and rate budgets; dashboard queries (next dates, stage, adverse orders); CSV export. Register new core exports in packages/db/src/testing/cross-tenant-registry.ts with real cases in packages/core/src/__tests__/cross-tenant/services.test.ts; update CORE_DOMAIN_DEPENDENCIES and docs/engineering/core-domains.md. Acceptance: importing 1,000 cases creates watches within rate budgets (integration).

subissues.title: feat(billing): per-tracked-case plan for institutions (#498 part 4)
subissues.body: Part of #498. Add a per-tracked-case plan kind to the plan catalogue and metering of tracked cases in packages/billing and core billing entitlements. Acceptance: charge computed from tracked case count with tests.

subissues.title: feat(b2b): exception alerts (new adverse order, missed date) to institution users (#498 part 5)
subissues.body: Part of #498. Add notification categories and a worker job/schedule that raises exception alerts for portfolio cases (new adverse order, missed date) to the institution's users; update apps/worker registry.test.ts and schedules.test.ts and the notification category tests. Acceptance: alerts reach institution users (integration).

subissues.title: feat(web): B2B portfolio import, dashboard and export UI (#498 part 6)
subissues.body: Part of #498. `apps/web/app/(app)/w/[slug]/portfolio/`: CSV import, dashboard (next dates, stage, adverse orders), exception alert settings, exports; i18n namespace and catalog test; cross-tenant-actions test entries for each 'use server' action.
